page.layout: One block of text, centred: a heading "LECTORI." over a paragraph with a large woodcut initial B; below it the closing word "VALE" set apart; then a row of asterisks with the signature mark "3". No margin notes. The Google digitiser stamp at lower right is excluded.

main_text.head: LECTORI.
main_text.p: BENEVOLUS Lector, ut vitia Typographica pro benevolentiâ suâ corrigat, rogat Typographus: Irrepsere ob mortem Authoris, absentiam Correctoris & hyemis injuriam, cum Corrector quandoque in loco non esset.

page.notes: The initial B is a woodcut ornamental letter and is joined to the word "Benevolus" as printed ("Enevolus" in the scan with the B as initial). The printed text reads "Enevolus Lector", with the B shown as the decorated initial; the word is transcribed as "BENEVOLUS" with the initial included. The word "Benevolus" should be checked against the scan. "VALE" is set in spaced capitals and is not a heading. The asterisk row ends in the printed numeral 3 and is a signature mark, not a page number at the head.
